title: 第十五章 擒拿疑犯线索汇聚第十六章 扑朔迷离独对庆丰
content_zh:
喧闹无比的怡红院，霎时落针可闻。
“头，出事了。”
“棠哥儿，凶手好像刚走。”
不用他们多说，铁棠也明白了事情原委，快速吩咐了两句。
“袁骅去查验死者，保护现场，小岐你去外面通知巡捕过来。”
随后他大腿两条长筋一抖，一个箭步跃出房门，如同一条滑溜溜的泥鳅，从满堂嫖客之中挤了过去。
怡红院自然不会只有正门一条出路，刚刚骚动的方向，便是后门那边。
一出人堆，铁棠看见身前十丈方向，有一位青衣男子已经出了后门，在街道上狂奔。
“哪里走？”
铁棠十个脚趾骤然发力，长筋震动，犹如弹拉弓弦，鸣响不止。
只见他两个脚掌一弓，弹射而起，在左右两边梁柱各留下一个深深的脚印。
秋夜蝉鸣，闻风而动。
这式身法正是八步赶蝉，即便铁棠只是堪堪入门，但他易筋大成的修为又岂是等闲？
十丈距离，转瞬即至。
亡命逃窜的青衣男子，猛然察觉后背寒毛竖起，脖颈发凉，知晓有高手接近。
他也是武道中人，察觉劲风袭来，也不再奔逃。
一个转身，两臂张开，右脚轻点地面，整个人往后退去，如同仙鹤展翅，躲掉了铁棠攻势。
此时铁棠才看清对方面目，竟是个年轻人，二十四五上下。
“你是何人，为何逃窜。”
青衣男子眼眶通红，似是刚刚哭过，闻言只是说了一句：“你找错人了了。”

随后再度转身奔逃。
不过方才他都没有逃走，这时铁棠离他不过一丈不到距离，怎么可能让他离开。
“留下说话！”
一个箭步前冲，两腿拉出大大的弓步，铁棠甩出右手，如同长猿探臂，山鹰夺食，抓向青衣男子。
但对方毫不示弱，头也不回，反手一拳狠狠打在铁棠右臂之上。
砰！
一击正中。
却并没有想象中的效果。
青衣男子只觉铁棠右臂宛如蛟龙之躯，劲道充足，皮坚骨硬，一条条长筋绷起，硬是将自己攻势挡了下来。
“别动！”
“再动你右臂就没了。”
铁棠右手搭在他的肩膀之上，五爪成型，宛如鹰爪。
只要一发力，青衣男子身上多五个窟窿都是轻的，随意便能把他整个臂膀扯下来。
大力鹰爪功非但指力惊人，更能擒拿挫骨、点穴分筋。
青衣男子缓缓转过半个脑袋，侧着脸说道：“你这是何意？无端阻我去路，滥用武力，难道不怕运城捕快吗？”
铁棠乐了。
“锻骨境？大成还是圆满？哪家人士？”若非早前晋升到易筋，一时半会还真拿不下他。
“放手，事情闹大了你也没好处。”青衣男子抖动肩膀。
此时前后方都有捕快、捕役快速赶来，有些是比岐喊过来的巡捕，有些则是被此处打斗惊扰。
“总捕头！”

“总捕头！”
........
眼见人手到了，铁棠缓缓放开右臂。
content_en:
The extremely noisy Yihong Courtyard can be heard instantly.
"Boss, something happened."
"Brother Tang, it seems the murderer just left."
They didn't need to say much, Tie Tang understood the whole story and gave a few quick instructions.
"Yuan Hua goes to check on the deceased and protect the scene. Xiao Qi, go outside and notify the patrolman."
Then the two long tendons in his thighs trembled, and he jumped out of the door in one stride, like a slippery loach, squeezing through the crowd of prostitutes.
Naturally, there is no only way out of Yihongyuan from the front entrance. The direction of the commotion just now is from the back entrance.
As soon as he got out of the crowd, Tie Tang saw a man in Tsing Yi who was ten feet in front of him running out of the back door and running wildly on the street.
"Where to go?"
Tietang's ten toes suddenly exerted force, and the long tendons vibrated, just like pulling a bow string, and the sound continued.
I saw the soles of his feet arching and shooting up, leaving deep footprints on the left and right beams.
The cicadas chirp on the autumn night and move when they hear the wind.
This body technique is exactly the eight steps to catch cicadas. Even if Tie Tang is just a beginner, how can his cultivation of Yi Jin be nothing?
The distance of ten feet was reached in an instant.
The man in green, who was running for his life, suddenly noticed that the hair on his back stood up and his neck felt cold, knowing that a master was approaching.
He is also a martial artist. When he noticed the strong wind coming, he stopped running away.
He turned around, opened his arms, tapped his right foot on the ground, and stepped back like a crane spreading its wings, avoiding Tie Tang's attack.
Only then did Tie Tang see the other person's face clearly. He was actually a young man, about twenty-four or five years old.
"Who are you and why are you running away?"
The man in green's eyes were red, as if he had just cried. Hearing this, he just said: "You have found the wrong person."
Then he turned around and ran away again.
But he didn't run away just now. Now Tie Tang was only less than ten feet away from him, how could he let him leave.
"Stay and talk!"
Lunging forward with both legs in a big lunge, Tie Tang threw out his right hand, like a long ape reaching for its arm or a mountain eagle grabbing food and grabbing at the man in green.
But the opponent showed no weakness, didn't look back, and hit Tie Tang hard on his right arm with a backhand punch.
Bang!
A hit that hit the spot.
But it didn't have the expected effect.
The man in Tsing Yi felt that Tietang's right arm was like the body of a dragon. It was strong, the skin was hard, and the muscles were stretched, and it blocked his attack.
"Don't move!"
"If you move your right arm again, it will be gone."
Tie Tang's right hand rested on his shoulder, with five claws shaped like eagle claws.
As long as he exerts force, the five holes in the man in green's body are all light, and his entire arm can be ripped off at will.
The powerful eagle claw skill not only has amazing finger strength, but can also capture and crush bones, tap acupoints and separate tendons.
The man in green slowly turned half his head and said sideways, "What do you mean? You are blocking my way for no reason and using force excessively. Aren't you afraid of the Yuncheng police?"
Tie Tang was happy.
"Bone Forging Realm? Dacheng or Perfection? Which family?" If he hadn't been promoted to Yijin earlier, he wouldn't have been able to defeat him for a while.
"Let go, it won't do you any good if things get serious." The man in green shook his shoulders.
At this time, there were police officers and soldiers coming from the front and rear quickly. Some were patrol officers called over by Biqi, and some were disturbed by the fighting here.
"The chief catcher!"
"The chief catcher!"
........
Seeing that the man's hand had arrived, Tie Tang slowly let go of his right arm.
